name: annotated-trend-chart
title: Annotated trend chart
author: Eduardo Retana
description: An SVG trend with a target line, a highlighted band, an end value, and a comparison series. line-chart remains the generic crosshair chart.

meta.descriptionEs: Una curva SVG con meta, banda, valor final y serie de comparación. line-chart sigue siendo la tendencia genérica.
meta.usage: <AnnotatedTrendChart label="Reopen rate" series={series} yFormat="percent" target={{ y: 0.04, label: "Target 4%" }} />

api.name: series
api.description: Points and emphasis primary or muted.

api.name: target / bands / markers
api.description: A dashed target, a tinted range, and point labels.

api.name: locale / yFormat
api.description: Intl formatting for the axis, tooltip, and table.

docs: Independent implementation of a common dashboard pattern. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite a primitive the host already has.
